before.algorithm: Rebuild selected content and full-text strings for each query, then lowercase candidate text per token

after.algorithm: Prepare selected content and lowercase full-text strings once per mount, then search literal tokens and stop after eight matches

limits: Local CPU microbenchmark, not browser typing latency, network performance, CWV or real visitor timing.
Prepared index construction is an up-front mount cost and is excluded from repeated-query samples.
The baseline algorithm is evaluated against the same current content as the optimized algorithm, rather than comparing different article sizes.
